title: Class of 2026
subtitle: GILD's Founding Cohort of Delegates & Diplomats
motto: Per Concordiam et Sapientiam, Mundum Coniungimus (Through Concord and Wisdom, We Connect the World)
oath: I solemnly pledge to wield dialogue before discord, to honor the sovereign dignity of African nations, to champion truth in multilateral counsel, and to dedicate my voice, my intellect, and my honor to the peaceful advancement of our communities and the world.

diplomats.name: Suleiman Yusuf Othman
diplomats.bio: High Commissioner of GILD International, High Commissioner of ASIRS, and President of the Department of International Relations & Diplomacy at Kaduna State University (KASU). Lead negotiator on regional peacekeeping accords.

diplomats.name: Kashim Hamza
diplomats.bio: Head Delegate of GILD International, serving alongside Suleiman Yusuf Othman in the Founding Directorate.

diplomats.name: Abdulaziz Abdulrahman Idris
diplomats.bio: Scholar in the Department of International Relations & Diplomacy, KASU. Specialist in West African regional border protocols and youth conflict mediation.

diplomats.name: Alamin Sanusi
diplomats.bio: Delegate representing GILD International in diplomatic studies and regional policy simulations.

diplomats.name: Abdulbasid Bashir Muaz
diplomats.bio: Student leader in the Department of Political Science, Kaduna State University. Focuses on democratic governance, institutional diplomacy, and legislative procedures.

diplomats.name: Abdulmalik Bashir Sakadadi
diplomats.bio: Researches international humanitarian law, internally displaced persons (IDP) rehabilitation protocols, and child education pacts across Northern Nigeria.

diplomats.name: Aliyu Alto Sada
diplomats.bio: Department of International Relations & Diplomacy, KASU. Specializing in trans-African economic trade barriers, currency harmonization, and youth entrepreneurship treaties.
